scope.selectionPolicy: After excluding KNOT agent 2295 and the separately audited agent 2293, this bounded pass inspected the first five results whose registered name or description explicitly described lending health-factor, Venus, Aave, or liquidation-risk work. Seed-only agent 2292 and range-health agents 2235 and 2234 were not treated as callable lending-health candidates.

summary.conclusion: Five additional registered health candidates were inspected. Keel completed one read-only Venus task but did not honor the requested block; Health Factor Guardian V2 returned an unsigned, task-unbound price response. No candidate passed every gate through verifiable quote capability and hireability.
